title: Exergis
extract:
Exergis is a Corpus shotgun that shatters a crystal into enemies, puncturing them with devastating  Radiation shards. Its extremely high damage output, large status chance, and reload speed make up for its single round, poor critical chance, and critical multiplier.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Innate multishot of 3 pellets.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Primary  Shotgun weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Highest base damage of all primary shotguns.
No auto-reload delay.
Innate Infinite Body Punch Through, and 0.5 meter punch through for surfaces.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High average number of procs per shot (1.08)
Very high maximum falloff distance (60.0 m)
Above average fire rate (3.33 attacks/sec)
Very high active falloff slope (59.1m/%)
Above average accuracy (5.00° to 8.00°)
Very high total damage (1,620)
High reload speed (1.60 s)
High status chance (36.00%)
Very high damage per shot (1671.84)
Disadvantages over other Primary  Shotgun weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 49.2% from 30m to 60m target distance (distances are affected by Projectile Speed).
Projectiles have travel time.
Lowest pellet count of all pellet shotguns.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low crit chance (8.00%)
Below average burst DPS (1044.9)
Low multishot (3)
Very low crit multiplier (1.40x)
Low average number of crits per shot (0.24)
Very low magazine size (1)
Very low ammo pickup (15)
Very low ammo max (47)
Below average disposition (●●●○○ (1.10x))
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
The Exergis's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Notes
Although the Arsenal shows a huge accuracy increase when using  Tainted Shell, there doesn't seem to be a notable accuracy difference in practice.

Bugs
 Galvanized Savvy is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits.
Projectiles generated by modded multishot do not benefit from accuracy bonuses such as  Tainted Shell.

Tips
As the Exergis is a single-shot weapon, its firing speed is largely determined by its reload speed. Thus, any mods that decrease firing speed can be equipped with a relatively small penalty, while those that increase it should be avoided in favor of reload speed mods.
Equipping any mod that gives (at least) +50% magazine capacity will increase the magazine capacity to 2. At +150% it goes to 3, and all the way to 4 by using all four magazine capacity mods:  Primed Ammo Stock,  Shotgun Elementalist,  Atomic Fallout and  Burdened Magazine.
Adding  Primary Crux with its 60% Ammo efficiency, you could shoot up to 10 times (depending on luck) before needing to reload. A riven with +Magazine Capacity, and other Ammo efficiency buffs could take it even further, if unnecessarily so.
Building for higher magazine capacity lets the weapon take actual advantage of its relatively high firerate, and dramatically cuts down on its otherwise frequent reloads.
The Exergis' infinite punch through against bodies synergizes with  Magnetize and  Void status, causing the pellets to continually rebound towards the center of the bubble.

Trivia
The projectile is made from a crystal that grows as the user "reloads" the weapon, hovering between two points before being shattered and its projectiles expelled outward. Not only is this unique for any weapon in Warframe, but it makes increasing Multishot more realistic, as the weapon can simply shatter a more powerful crystal into more shards.
The crystal only grows back on reload, as such firing a second shot by having 2 in the magazine will not grow a crystal. If you have 3 in the magazine, the third shot also will have no recoil animation and actual weapon recoil will be lower on this third shot.
The weapon's name is a corruption of the word "Exert" and "Exegesis", A critical explanation of text, mainly religious text.
